'''FS La Massana''' is an Andorran football club based in the parish of [[La Massana]], founded in 2005.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Andorra – List of Foundation Dates |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/andofound.html |access-date=2025-07-22 |website=rsssf.org}}</ref> The club currently competes in the [[Segona Divisió]] and the [[Copa Constitució]]."}}
